name: finem-security-privacy
description: Protect identity, permissions, secrets and personal data, and assess concrete security risks in the implementation.

interface.longDescription:
Protect identity, permissions, secrets and personal data, and assess concrete security risks in the implementation.

Covers: Auth, Secrets/IAM, Security, Privacy/compliance.

Expected outputs: Authentication and authorization controls; IAM and secret handling; Security findings and mitigations; Privacy, retention and compliance requirements.

Original skills used through Engineering Core: wshobson:auth-implementation-patterns, addy:security-and-hardening, pulumi:pulumi-esc, wshobson:secrets-management, wshobson:gdpr-data-handling.

Optional specialist and framework packs: advanced-testing, intent-audit, backend-django, auth-auth0, kubernetes, security-audit. These are selected for the project when relevant; they are not all enabled by default.

Declared integrations: context7, db-provider, cloud-provider, github. These are integration recipes, not connected services; configure the corresponding tools and accounts separately.

Why the app shows one skill: this plugin exposes one entry skill which loads the relevant original specialists from Engineering Core on demand. The Skills count in the app is not the size of the shared upstream library.

Requires Engineering Core (finem-core). Tasks spanning multiple disciplines may also require the corresponding area plugins.
defaultPrompt: Inspect this project for Security & Privacy and recommend the relevant original skills and framework packs.
Review Security & Privacy in this project and prioritize concrete improvements with verification steps.
